data.title: Software Engineer for Networked Sensor Systems
data.description:
Description

Are you a software engineer interested in developing innovative modeling and simulation tools to help solve challenging real-world problems?

 

Would you like the opportunity to apply your software development expertise to building advanced simulation capabilities that support the development and evaluation of next-generation defense systems?

 

If so, we’re looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

 

The Networked Systems and Integrated Fires Group is seeking a Software Engineer to develop, enhance, and maintain modeling and simulation tools that support the analysis and development of advanced sensing, tracking, and integrated defense systems. You will work with a multidisciplinary team of software engineers, signal processing engineers, and systems analysts to build robust, efficient, and flexible simulation capabilities for evaluating complex systems and innovative technical concepts. Your work will involve improving existing software tools, developing new capabilities, and applying modern software engineering practices to support the development of future defense systems.
data.qualifications:
You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you…

 

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
data.responsibilities:
Are you a software engineer interested in developing innovative modeling and simulation tools to help solve challenging real-world problems?

 

Would you like the opportunity to apply your software development expertise to building advanced simulation capabilities that support the development and evaluation of next-generation defense systems?

data.title: 2027 Internship - Mechanical Fabrication Intern
data.description:
Description

Are you searching for an internship experience that includes interesting and impactful engineering work? 

 

Do you have a passion for manufacturing complex mechanical hardware and prototype development?

 

If you’re pursuing a degree in engineering and want to gain experience, we’d love to have you join our team!

 

We are seeking an intern to help us produce mechanical hardware for APL. As a member of our team, your primary contribution will be supporting missions for space exploration, operational prototypes and manufacturing science. You will be joining a hardworking team of engineers and scientists who manufacture flight hardware and develop prototypes. We are passionate about our mission and to our commitment of providing high quality hardware.  We strive to foster an environment of shared learning and value growth and technical excellence.
data.qualifications:
You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you…

  • Are pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering.
  • Have a passion for fabricating complex hardware and prototypes.
  • Have a minimum 3.0 overall GPA on a 4.0 scale.
data.responsibilities:
Are you searching for an internship experience that includes interesting and impactful engineering work? 

 

Do you have a passion for manufacturing complex mechanical hardware and prototype development?

data.title: Sensor and Detector Design Engineer
data.description:
Description

Are you passionate about developing next-generation infrared sensors and electro-optical instrumentation for groundbreaking space missions?

 

Do you want to see the technology you design fly on missions that advance our understanding of the solar system?

 

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

 

We are seeking talented engineers with expertise in infrared sensors, detector characterization, and electro-optical instrumentation to contribute to the research, development, integration, and testing of spaceflight instruments. If you are passionate about infrared detector technologies, focal plane arrays, and advancing state-of-the-art instrumentation for spaceflight missions, we would be excited to have you join our team.
data.qualifications:
You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you have...

  • A Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent technical field, with 2+ years of experience in sensor and detector systems design.
data.responsibilities:
Are you passionate about developing next-generation infrared sensors and electro-optical instrumentation for groundbreaking space missions?

 

Do you want to see the technology you design fly on missions that advance our understanding of the solar system?
